🚨 CVE-2026-82416 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.7
Resumo:
FrankenPHP is a modern application server for PHP. Prior to 1.12.5, FrankenPHP worker mode can retain PHP session state between requests when the session extension is loaded as a shared module and is unavailable through HAVE_PHP_SESSION at compile time. In this build configuration, frankenphp_reset_session_state() is compiled out, PS(id) can survive a request boundary, and a subsequent session_start() can ignore the...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-82416
 
🚨 CVE-2026-101019 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
Description NGINX JavaScript (njs) has a vulnerability where the njs XML module exposes entity-backed XML attributes inconsistently with libxml2 canonicalization. In both the built-in njs and QuickJS backends during the canonicalization process, the $attr$Name getter may return undefined for an explicitly present attribute containing an internal entity reference. The $attrs getter may return a value derived only from...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-101019

💣 Drupal Patches Critical Field UI Flaw With Unauthenticated RCE Path via Contributed Modules
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 1.4
Resumo:
Drupal core has a critical flaw in its Field UI module that could let an attacker run code on the site's server, and fixes were shipped on October 14 in Drupal 11.4.10, 11.3.19, and 10.6.19. An attacker cannot reach the flaw through core alone, the Drupal Security Team said in its advisory. Several exploit paths exist through contributed modules, and at least one known path needs no login.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/drupal-patches-critical-core-rce-flaw.html

🚨 Fixes available for CVE-2026-92392 and other curl vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/blog/feed
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Introduction On 7 October 2026, Daniel Stenberg published a blog post describing a plan to release a new version of curl on 14 October 2026 in order to address 22 known security vulnerabilities. These vulnerabilities have varying severities, with a single vulnerability assessed as high (CVE-2026-92392), while the others have a low or medium severity.

🚨 CVE-2026-93294 - Azure
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Azure
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.3
Resumo:
A user with query access to an Azure Monitor data source can use its resource proxy to call Azure Resource Manager APIs beyond those Grafana needs, with the data source's Azure identity (unintended proxy). The impact is bounded by the Azure role granted to that identity.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-93294
